# Nov 7,  finalized schematic
### *if you're wondering why this entry is suspiciously close to the next one, it's because I kinda forgot to journal this entry so I'm doing it right before that one*

## The schematic right now

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 at 6.26.46 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/gNkPHeHGznptF1i3IfiQvYlXX9m4reaM/af22605ac41ebdf988cef26cba79b659e7c242cda78c11b14887e4c5264884d5.png)

## What this entire project is
- Pretty much a game controller in a modified version of the xbox layout, designed for use with phones (and steam link)

## decisions I made

- Used the Seedstudio rp2040 mainly due to it being the only one I had a footprint for that included USB-C

- Used Shift registers due to that board not having enough io for all of the 17 buttons + the joysticks

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 at 6.30.09 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/gNkPHeHGznptF1i3IfiQvYlXX9m4reaM/26dbbc8170705b5313461ed2db1595bfe9fecc0b208409bf9d48c3b4a418c2bc.png)
^ the shift registers in question

- Used resistor networks instead of individual networks for simplicity

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 at 6.31.35 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/gNkPHeHGznptF1i3IfiQvYlXX9m4reaM/654189c44dc57d6d75e0d0b0f001a06995c9e0900af87ceb67e6c150e94ad861.png)
